senses.gloss: m., constr. טֵיקַס, טֵקַס, (preced.) banner, arrangement of troops, standard, division belonging to one standard (corresp. to h. דֶּגֶל).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 2:2">Targ. Num. II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 2:3">3</cite>; a. fr. Y.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 2:3">ib.</cite> <he>וטִיקְסֵיה וכ׳</he> and its banner was made of wool &c.—Pl. <cite ref="I00322"><he>טִיקְסִין</he></cite>, <he>טִיקְסַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="I00423"><he>טִקְ׳</he></cite>. Ib. 17; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 6:4">Targ. Cant. VI, 4</cite> <he>ארבע טִקְסַיִךְ וכ׳</he> thy four divisions in the desert.—[<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>טִיקְסַיָּה</he> Ar., ed. <he>טכס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="I00361"><he>טִיכְסָא</he></cite>].
